title: EEG-based functional connectivity uncovers frequency-specific brain network alterations induced by nostalgic music.
summary: This study aimed to clarify the neural mechanisms of nostalgic music by exploring differences in brain functional connectivity between nostalgic and non-nostalgic music using EEG-derived imaginary coherence (iCOH), which minimizes volume conduction artifacts. Thirty-six healthy right-handed participants (mean age: 22.5 ± 3.2 years, 17 males) completed a passive auditory paradigm, listening to 25 nostalgic music tracks (selected via alignment with participants' childhood/teenage years, interviews, and questionnaires) and 5 non-nostalgic tracks. EEG data were recorded with a 64-channel cap (10-10 system, 1000 Hz sampling rate), preprocessed (artifact removal via independent component analysis, 1-50 Hz band-pass filtering), and analyzed for power spectral density (PSD) and iCOH across δ (1-4 Hz), θ (4-8 Hz), α (8-13 Hz), β (13-30 Hz), and γ (30-50 Hz) bands. Behaviorally, nostalgic music elicited significantly higher nostalgia degree (7.61 ± 0.87 vs. 3.81 ± 1.22), pleasantness (7.18 ± 1.01 vs. 4.91 ± 0.88), and arousal (7.18 ± 0.90 vs. 4.96 ± 1.08, all p < 0.001) than non-nostalgic music. Neurally, nostalgic music increased δ-band PSD (frontal: Fp1/Fp2; central: Cz/C2; parieto-occipital: P4/O2) and θ-band PSD (frontal: FC1/FC2/Cz/C2, p < 0.01). For iCOH, nostalgic music showed widespread δ-band connectivity increases (frontal-temporal-parietal-occipital pairs), enhanced θ-band frontotemporal connectivity, and elevated α-band parieto-occipital connectivity (all p < 0.01), with no differences in β/γ bands. Conclusion: Nostalgic music modulates brain function via frequency-specific connectivity, supporting low-interference memory retrieval (δ), emotion-memory integration (θ), and visual memory processing (α), highlighting its potential for emotional regulation.

标题：基于EEG的功能连接揭示怀旧音乐诱发的频率特异性脑网络改变
摘要：本研究旨在通过使用最小化容积传导伪迹的EEG衍生虚拟相干性（iCOH），探索怀旧音乐与非怀旧音乐之间脑功能连接的差异，以阐明怀旧音乐的神经机制。36名健康右利手参与者（平均年龄22.5±3.2岁，17名男性）完成了一项被动听觉范式，聆听25首怀旧音乐曲目（通过匹配参与者童年/青少年时期、访谈和问卷筛选）和5首非怀旧曲目。使用64通道脑电帽（10-10系统，1000 Hz采样率）记录EEG数据，经过预处理（通过独立成分分析去除伪迹，1-50 Hz带通滤波），并分析了δ（1-4 Hz）、θ（4-8 Hz）、α（8-13 Hz）、β（13-30 Hz）和γ（30-50 Hz）频段的功率谱密度（PSD）和iCOH。行为上，怀旧音乐比非怀旧音乐诱发了显著更高的怀旧程度（7.61±0.87 vs. 3.81±1.22）、愉悦度（7.18±1.01 vs. 4.91±0.88）和唤醒度（7.18±0.90 vs. 4.96±1.08，所有p<0.001）。神经层面，怀旧音乐增加了δ频段PSD（额叶：Fp1/Fp2；中央区：Cz/C2；顶枕叶：P4/O2）和θ频段PSD（额叶：FC1/FC2/Cz/C2，p<0.01）。在iCOH方面，怀旧音乐显示出广泛的δ频段连接增强（额叶-颞叶-顶叶-枕叶配对），增强的θ频段额颞连接，以及升高的α频段顶枕连接（所有p<0.01），而β/γ频段无差异。结论：怀旧音乐通过频率特异性连接调节脑功能，支持低频记忆检索（δ）、情绪-记忆整合（θ）和视觉记忆加工（α），凸显了其在情绪调节中的潜力。
关键词：怀旧音乐；脑电图；功能连接；情绪调节；频率特异性

title: Toward a computational analogy of emotion regulation: A closed-loop framework integrating motivation, execution, and feedback.
summary: This paper conceptualizes emotion regulation (ER) as a dynamic, closed-loop control system composed of three interlinked stages: motivation, execution, and monitoring. In contrast to traditional models that assume static and sequential progression, we propose a recursive ER framework where emotional goals, strategy implementation, and feedback evaluation interact continuously to maintain affective homeostasis. The first part of the paper delineates the psychological architecture of each stage and examines their dynamic inter-dependencies. The second part introduces computational analogies that map core ER processes onto machine learning mechanisms such as loss functions, policy selection, and prediction error-based updating. Drawing on this analogy, ER is described as a self-correcting system that recalibrates emotional states through threshold-sensitive adjustments. This framework provides a unifying model for understanding ER as a feedback-driven, adaptive process, offering new avenues for theory-building, simulation, and clinical modeling within affective science and computational approaches to emotional control.

标题：情绪调节的计算类比：一个整合动机、执行与反馈的闭环框架
摘要：本文将情绪调节概念化为一个由动机、执行与监控三个相互关联阶段组成的动态闭环控制系统。与传统模型假设静态且顺序推进不同，我们提出一个递归式情绪调节框架，其中情绪目标、策略实施与反馈评价持续交互以维持情感稳态。论文第一部分阐述了各阶段的心理架构及其动态相互依赖关系；第二部分引入计算类比，将情绪调节核心过程映射到机器学习机制（如损失函数、策略选择与基于预测误差的更新）。基于此类比，情绪调节被描述为一个通过阈值敏感调整重新校准情绪状态的自我修正系统。该框架为理解情绪调节作为反馈驱动的自适应过程提供了统一模型，为情感科学与情绪控制计算方法的理论构建、仿真及临床建模开辟了新路径。

title: The CODE model: Object-mediated play as a scalable framework for dyadic co-regulation in early childhood.
summary: The field of early childhood mental health faces a persistent and well-documented "implementation gap": evidence-based interventions for dyadic co-regulation work in clinics, but remain too resource-intensive to reach most families in everyday settings. This article introduces the CODE Model, an interdisciplinary framework designed to address this gap by reconfiguring the delivery of early regulatory support from therapist-mediated protocols to object-mediated, caregiver-implemented routines. Grounded in developmental psychology, interactional linguistics, and cognitive science-specifically theories of distributed cognition and affordances-the model conceptualizes Co-regulation (the goal), Object-mediation (the tool), and Dyadic Exchange (the process) as three interlocking pillars. We advance a framework for what we term distributed regulation - a specific modality of co-regulation in which selected regulatory functions typically provided by a therapist are partially redistributed into the design of tangible play materials. Drawing on broader work on distributed forms of emotion and learning regulation (e.g., Panadero, 2017; Varga & Krueger, 2013), the term describes how co-regulation can be enacted when carefully designed objects carry part of the scaffolding load, rather than this load being held entirely in the caregiver's working memory. These materials are intentionally designed to externalize regulatory scripts, serving as "material anchors" that reduce caregiver cognitive load and invite turn-taking, joint attention, and repair in everyday interaction. As a conceptual paper, we outline the model's theoretical foundations, describe its operational cycle (Trigger-Intervention-Resolution), and articulate preliminary design criteria for translating psychological constructs into physical affordances. Finally, we discuss how digitally fabricated, low-cost toolkits (e.g., via 3D printing) could enable scalable, culturally adaptable dissemination, and consider the implications of object-mediated scaffolding for democratizing access to preventive early childhood mental health support.

标题：CODE模型：以物体为中介的游戏作为幼儿二元共同调节的可扩展框架  
摘要：幼儿心理健康领域面临一个持续且被充分记录的“实施鸿沟”：基于证据的二元共同调节干预措施在诊所中有效，但在日常环境中因资源密集而难以覆盖大多数家庭。本文介绍了CODE模型，这是一个跨学科框架，旨在通过将早期调节支持的提供从以治疗师为中介的方案重构为以物体为中介、由照护者实施的常规活动来应对这一鸿沟。该模型植根于发展心理学、互动语言学与认知科学——特别是分布式认知与可供性理论——将共同调节（目标）、物体中介（工具）和二元交流（过程）概念化为三个相互关联的支柱。我们提出一个称为分布式调节的框架——这是一种特定的共同调节模式，其中通常由治疗师提供的部分调节功能被部分重新分配到有形的游戏材料设计中。借鉴情绪与学习调节的分布式形式研究（如Panadero, 2017；Varga & Krueger, 2013），该术语描述了当精心设计的物品承担部分支架负荷（而非完全依赖照护者的工作记忆）时如何实现共同调节。这些材料有意识地设计为外化调节脚本，作为“物质锚点”，减轻照护者的认知负荷，并在日常互动中引发轮流、共同注意与修复。作为一篇概念性论文，我们概述了模型的理论基础，描述了其操作循环（触发-干预-解决），并阐述了将心理构念转化为物理可供性的初步设计标准。最后，我们讨论了数字制造的低成本工具包（如通过3D打印）如何实现可扩展、文化适应性强的传播，并探讨了以物体为中介的支架在普及预防性幼儿心理健康支持方面的意义。  
关键词：共同调节；物体中介；情绪调节；早期儿童；分布式认知

title: The impact of maternal harsh parenting on depression in primary school students: A three-wave time-lagged study.
summary:
OBJECTIVE: This study investigates the impact of maternal harsh parenting on depression in primary school students in China, with a particular focus on the mediating role of children's emotional regulation and the moderating role of paternal mindful parenting.
METHODS: A convenience sampling method was used to survey 536 families in China. Data were collected in three waves, employing a series of validated questionnaires to assess maternal harsh parenting, children's emotional regulation, paternal mindful parenting, and depression in primary school students.
RESULTS: Maternal harsh parenting was found to significantly predict depression in primary school students. Children's emotional regulation was identified as a mediator in this relationship. Furthermore, paternal mindful parenting moderated the effects of maternal harsh parenting on both depression in primary school students and emotional regulation.
CONCLUSION: Maternal harsh parenting impacts depression in primary school students both directly and indirectly through emotional regulation. Paternal mindful parenting serves as a protective factor, mitigating the negative effects of maternal harsh parenting on both depression and emotional regulation in children. This study highlights the importance of acknowledging the protective role of fathers in child development within family interventions and mental health promotion, especially as a compensatory factor when maternal parenting involves negative behaviors.

标题：母亲严厉教养对小学生抑郁的影响：一项三波时滞研究
摘要：目的：本研究探讨中国母亲严厉教养对小学生抑郁的影响，重点关注儿童情绪调节的中介作用以及父亲正念教养的调节作用。方法：采用便利抽样法，对中国536个家庭进行调查。数据分三波收集，使用一系列经过验证的问卷评估母亲严厉教养、儿童情绪调节、父亲正念教养和小学生抑郁。结果：母亲严厉教养显著预测小学生抑郁。儿童情绪调节被确定为这一关系的中介变量。此外，父亲正念教养调节了母亲严厉教养对小学生抑郁和情绪调节的影响。结论：母亲严厉教养通过情绪调节直接和间接影响小学生抑郁。父亲正念教养作为保护因素，缓解了母亲严厉教养对儿童抑郁和情绪调节的负面影响。本研究强调了在家庭干预和心理健康促进中承认父亲在儿童发展中的保护作用的重要性，尤其是在母亲养育行为涉及负面行为时作为一种补偿因素。
关键词：母亲严厉教养；小学生抑郁；情绪调节；父亲正念教养；家庭干预

title: Poverty as Biography in Motion: Agency, Emotion, and the Limits of Contemporary Poverty Theory.
summary: Despite extensive research, poverty remains theoretically under-explained. Dominant approaches oscillate between structural, resource-based models that conceptualise poverty as a measurable condition, and behavioural or responsibilisation accounts that locate persistence in individual conduct. Whilst often treated as opposing theses, this article argues that both rest on a shared theoretical error: the mis-specification of agency as either absent or over-moralised. As a result, poverty is rendered static, episodic, or behaviourally deficient, limiting the capacity of theory to explain endurance, stalling, and fragile change across lives. The article advances a different ontological starting point by reconceptualising poverty as a temporal, emotional, and biographical process. Drawing on feminist sociology, life-course theory, and narrative perspectives, it introduces the concept of poverty as biography in motion, alongside a trajectory-based analytic that theorises turbulence, stalling, and fragile progress as patterned temporal forms of constraint. Central to this framework is the treatment of emotion as a mediating mechanism through which structural conditions are lived, and agency is exercised over time. By reframing agency as situated, relational, and emotionally mediated, the article moves beyond entrenched binaries between structure and behaviour. It offers a theoretical grammar capable of explaining poverty's persistence and uneven movement without reverting to static or moralised accounts. In doing so, the article contributes to poverty theory by reorienting explanation toward lived process, duration, and mediation, and by foregrounding biography as a central site of sociological analysis.

标题：流动中的贫困传记：能动性、情感与当代贫困理论的边界
摘要：尽管已有大量研究，贫困在理论上仍未得到充分解释。主流研究范式在两种路径间摇摆：一是将贫困概念化为可测度状况的结构性、资源型模型，二是将贫困持续归因于个体行为的责任化叙述。本文认为，尽管二者常被视为对立命题，但它们共享一个理论误区：将能动性错误地界定为要么缺失、要么过度道德化。由此，贫困被呈现为静态、片段化或行为缺陷的状态，限制了理论解释贫困在生命历程中的持续性、停滞与脆弱变化的能力。本文通过将贫困重新概念化为一个时间性、情感性与传记性的过程，提出了一种不同的本体论起点。借鉴女性主义社会学、生命历程理论与叙事视角，本文引入了“流动中的贫困传记”这一概念，并构建了基于轨迹的分析框架，将动荡、停滞与脆弱进步理论化为模式化的时间性约束形式。该框架的核心是将情感视为结构性条件被体验、能动性随时间得以施展的中介机制。通过将能动性重新框定为情境化、关系性且情感中介的，本文超越了结构与行为之间的固有二元对立，提供了一种能够解释贫困持续性及不均衡运动的理论语法，且不重返静态或道德化的论述。由此，本文通过将解释转向生命过程、持续性与中介机制，并将传记凸显为社会学分析的核心场域，为贫困理论做出了贡献。
关键词：贫困理论；能动性；情感；生命历程；传记分析

title: The Linguistic Expression of Emotion: A Cross-Cultural Analysis
summary: This study examines the relationship between language and emotion through a cross-cultural lens, exploring how different linguistic structures influence emotional perception and expression. Grounded in the linguistic relativity hypothesis, it investigates whether the way emotions are categorized, verbalized, and understood differs across languages and cultural contexts. Through a theoretical and qualitative analysis of linguistic resources, multilingual corpora, and cross-cultural pragmatic frameworks, this study highlights significant differences in emotional articulation. Findings suggest that while basic emotions are universally recognized, their linguistic encoding varies; some languages provide finer distinctions between emotional states, while others rely on contextual rather than explicit expression. Western individualistic cultures tend to favor direct emotional articulation, whereas collectivist cultures often depend on indirect or pragmatic cues. Additionally, bilingual speakers report experiencing different emotional intensities depending on the language of expression, reinforcing the emotional resonance hypothesis. These insights have profound implications for cross-cultural communication, translation studies, and the cognitive processing of emotions. The study calls for further exploration of underrepresented languages and multilingual emotional articulation to gain a deeper understanding of the intricate relationship between language and emotion.

标题：情绪的语言表达：一项跨文化分析
摘要：本研究通过跨文化视角考察语言与情绪之间的关系，探索不同语言结构如何影响情绪感知和表达。基于语言相对性假说，研究调查了情绪在不同语言和文化背景中如何被分类、言语化及理解。通过对语言资源、多语语料库及跨文化语用框架的理论和定性分析，本研究揭示了情绪表达中的显著差异。研究结果表明，尽管基本情绪具有普遍认可性，但其语言编码存在差异；一些语言对情绪状态提供了更细致的区分，而另一些语言则依赖语境而非明确的表达。西方个人主义文化倾向于直接的情绪表达，而集体主义文化往往依赖间接或语用线索。此外，双语者报告称，根据表达所用语言的不同，他们所体验的情绪强度也有所差异，这进一步支持了情绪共鸣假说。这些发现对跨文化交流、翻译研究以及情绪认知加工具有深远意义。本研究呼吁进一步探索未被充分代表的语言及多语情绪表达，以更深入地理解语言与情绪之间的复杂关系。

title: Social Media Self-Presentation and Emotion
summary:
Abstract
               This chapter considers how social media self-presentations are implicated in users’ emotional lives. How are emotions presented on social media profiles? And to what extent do social media profiles affect users’ emotions? Three theoretical frameworks are offered to address these questions. First, the selective self-presentation framework provides insight into the valence of social media self-presentations, delineating why positive emotions are likely to be much more prominently displayed than negative emotions. Second, self-affirmation theory explicates the effect of social media self-presentations on self-directed emotions, showing why feelings of self-worth and self-esteem, as well as self-directed positive affect, are likely to be enhanced by one’s own social media self-presentations. Finally, the social sharing of emotions framework focuses on significant emotional events, explaining why and to what extent such events are presented on social media, and why social media amplifies the emotional resonance of these events. Directions for future research are discussed.

标题：社交媒体自我呈现与情绪
摘要：本章探讨了社交媒体自我呈现如何影响用户的情绪生活。情绪如何在社交媒体档案中呈现？社交媒体档案对用户情绪的影响程度如何？为此提出了三个理论框架。首先，选择性自我呈现框架揭示了社交媒体自我呈现的效价，解释了为何积极情绪比消极情绪更可能被突出展示。其次，自我肯定理论阐述了社交媒体自我呈现对自我导向情绪的影响，说明为何自我价值感、自尊以及自我导向的积极情感可能因个人的社交媒体自我呈现而增强。最后，情绪的社会分享框架聚焦于重要情绪事件，解释了为何以及此类事件在社交媒体上呈现的程度，并说明社交媒体为何放大这些事件的情绪共鸣。还讨论了未来研究方向。

title: Mood and Emotion in Major Depression
summary: Nothing is more familiar to people than their moods and emotions. Oddly, however, it is not clear how these two kinds of affective processes are related. Intuitively, it makes sense that emotional reactions are stronger when they are congruent with a preexisting mood, an idea reinforced by contemporary emotion theory. Yet empirically, it is uncertain whether moods actually facilitate emotional reactivity to mood-congruent stimuli. One approach to the question of how moods affect emotions is to study mood-disturbed individuals. This review describes recent experimental studies of emotional reactivity conducted with individuals suffering from major depression. Counter to intuitions, major depression is associated with reduced emotional reactivity to sad contexts. A novel account of emotions in depression is advanced to assimilate these findings. Implications for the study of depression and normal mood variation are considered.

标题：重度抑郁症中的情绪与情感
摘要：没有什么比人们的情绪和情感更为熟悉。然而奇怪的是，这两种情感过程如何关联尚不明确。直觉上，当情绪反应与预先存在的情绪状态一致时，这种反应会更强烈，这一观点得到了当代情绪理论的强化。但实证研究中，情绪是否实际促进了对情绪一致刺激的情绪反应性仍不确定。研究情绪如何影响情感的一种方法是考察情绪紊乱的个体。本综述描述了近年来对重度抑郁症患者进行的情绪反应性实验研究。与直觉相反，重度抑郁症与对悲伤情境的情绪反应性降低相关。本文提出了一种关于抑郁症中情绪的新解释，以整合这些发现，并探讨了其对抑郁症研究和正常情绪变异的意义。

title: Positive and Negative Emotion Regulation in Adolescence: Links to Anxiety and Depression
summary: Emotion regulation skills develop substantially across adolescence, a period characterized by emotional challenges and developing regulatory neural circuitry. Adolescence is also a risk period for the new onset of anxiety and depressive disorders, psychopathologies which have long been associated with disruptions in regulation of positive and negative emotions. This paper reviews the current understanding of the role of disrupted emotion regulation in adolescent anxiety and depression, describing findings from self-report, behavioral, peripheral psychophysiological, and neural measures. Self-report studies robustly identified associations between emotion dysregulation and adolescent anxiety and depression. Findings from behavioral and psychophysiological studies are mixed, with some suggestion of specific impairments in reappraisal in anxiety. Results from neuroimaging studies broadly implicate altered functioning of amygdala-prefrontal cortical circuitries, although again, findings are mixed regarding specific patterns of altered neural functioning. Future work may benefit from focusing on designs that contrast effects of specific regulatory strategies, and isolate changes in emotional regulation from emotional reactivity. Approaches to improve treatments based on empirical evidence of disrupted emotion regulation in adolescents are also discussed. Future intervention studies might consider training and measurement of specific strategies in adolescents to better understand the role of emotion regulation as a treatment mechanism.

标题：青少年期正性和负性情绪调节：与焦虑和抑郁的联系  
摘要：情绪调节能力在青少年期显著发展，这一时期以情绪挑战和调节神经回路发育为特征。青少年期也是焦虑症和抑郁症新发的高危时期，这些精神病理现象长期被认为与正性和负性情绪调节的失调有关。本文综述了当前关于情绪调节失调在青少年焦虑和抑郁中作用的理解，描述了来自自我报告、行为、外周心理生理和神经测量的研究结果。自我报告研究稳固地揭示了情绪失调与青少年焦虑和抑郁之间的关联。行为和心理生理研究的结果较为混杂，部分提示焦虑症患者在重评方面存在特定缺陷。神经影像学研究结果广泛提示杏仁核-前额叶皮层回路功能改变，但关于特定神经功能改变模式的结果同样较为混杂。未来研究或可受益于聚焦对比特定调节策略效果的实验设计，并将情绪调节的变化与情绪反应性相分离。本文还讨论了基于青少年情绪调节失调经验证据改善治疗方法的方法。未来的干预研究可考虑针对青少年进行特定策略的训练和测量，以更好地理解情绪调节作为治疗机制的作用。  
关键词：青少年；情绪调节；焦虑；抑郁；神经回路

title: Parallel Mediation of Relationship Happiness and Emotion Reactivity in the Relationship Between Family Harmony and Self-Concept Clarity in Parents
summary: The family environment in which an individual resides plays an important role in the shaping of self-perception. The absence of a harmonious family environment may make it difficult for the individual to develop a clear and stable self-concept clarity due to a lack of relationship happiness and emotional reactivity. Conversely, harmonious family support positively supports self-concept clarity by maintaining the individual’s relationship happiness and emotional balance. In this research, the parallel mediating roles of relationship happiness and emotion reactivity in the relationship between family harmony and self-concept clarity were examined. The model in question was tested for the first time in a sample of parents. A total of 310 adults, consisting of 63 males (20.3%) and 247 females (79.7%), participated in the research (Mean age = 38.40; SD = 7.66). Analyses conducted using structural equation modeling (SEM) showed that both variables assumed significant parallel mediating roles in the relationship between family harmony and self-concept clarity. The findings reveal that supporting parents’ relational and emotion regulation resources is important in strengthening self-concept clarity.

标题：家庭和谐与父母自我概念清晰度关系中关系幸福感与情绪反应性的并行中介作用  
摘要：个体所处的家庭环境在自我认知塑造中发挥着重要作用。缺乏和谐的家庭环境可能使个体因缺少关系幸福感和情绪反应性而难以形成清晰稳定的自我概念清晰度。相反，和谐的家庭支持通过维持个体的关系幸福感和情绪平衡，对自我概念清晰度产生积极支持。本研究考察了关系幸福感与情绪反应性在家庭和谐与自我概念清晰度关系中的并行中介作用。该模型首次以父母样本进行检验。共310名成年人参与研究，包括63名男性（20.3%）和247名女性（79.7%）（平均年龄=38.40；标准差=7.66）。采用结构方程模型（SEM）进行的分析显示，两个变量在家庭和谐与自我概念清晰度关系中均发挥了显著的并行中介作用。研究结果表明，支持父母的关系和情绪调节资源对于增强自我概念清晰度具有重要意义。  
关键词：家庭和谐；自我概念清晰度；关系幸福感；情绪反应性；并行中介效应

title: Sensory encoding of emotion conveyed by the face and visual context
summary:
Abstract
                  Humans rapidly detect and interpret sensory signals that have emotional meaning. The posterior superior temporal sulcus (pSTS) and amygdala are known to be critical for this ability, but their precise contributions remain contentious. Here we investigate how these structures process visual emotional cues using artificial neural networks (ANNs) to model fMRI signal acquired as human participants view complex, naturalistic stimuli. Characterizing data from two archival studies (Ns = 20, 45), we evaluated whether representations from ANNs optimized to recognize emotion from facial expressions alone or the broader visual scene differ in their ability to predict brain responses. We found that abstract representations of facial expressions were more strongly encoded in pSTS than the amygdala, whereas representations of the broader emotional scene were robustly encoded in both regions. These findings demonstrate how the pSTS operates on abstract representations of facial expressions to a greater extent than the amygdala, which more strongly encodes the broader emotional significance of visual information, depending on the context.

标题：人脸与视觉情境所传达情绪的感觉编码  
摘要：人类能快速检测并解读具有情绪意义的感觉信号。已知后上颞沟（pSTS）和杏仁核对此能力至关重要，但它们的精确贡献仍存争议。本研究利用人工神经网络（ANN）对受试者在观看复杂自然刺激时的fMRI信号进行建模，探究这些结构如何处理视觉情绪线索。通过对两项档案研究（样本量分别为20和45）的数据进行表征分析，我们评估了仅从面部表情识别或从更广泛的视觉场景中优化得到的ANN表征在预测大脑反应能力上的差异。结果发现，面部表情的抽象表征在pSTS中的编码强度高于杏仁核，而更广泛情绪场景的表征在两个脑区均有稳健编码。这些发现表明，pSTS对面部表情抽象表征的处理程度高于杏仁核，而杏仁核则依据情境更强地编码视觉信息的整体情绪意义。  
关键词：情绪编码；后上颞沟；杏仁核；人工神经网络；面部表情

title: Emotion Regulation in Depression
summary: Sustained negative affect and difficulties experiencing positive affect are hallmark features of major depressive disorder. Recent research has suggested that difficulties in emotion regulation are at the core of these cardinal symptoms of major depressive disorder; depressed patients exhibit more frequent use of maladaptive emotion regulation and difficulties effectively implementing adaptive strategies. It remains unclear, however, what underlies these difficulties in emotion regulation. Cognitive theories of depression have a long tradition of focusing on cognitive factors that increase depression risk and maintain depressive episodes, but the link between cognitive and affective aspects of major depressive disorder remains to be explored. We propose that cognitive biases and deficits in cognitive control putatively associated with depression affect emotion regulation in critical ways, thereby setting the stage for maintained negative affect and diminished levels of positive affect. We close with a discussion of implications for treatment and future directions for research in this area.

标题：抑郁症中的情绪调节  
摘要：持续的负性情绪和体验正性情绪的困难是重度抑郁症的典型特征。近期研究表明，情绪调节困难是这些核心症状的基础；抑郁症患者更频繁地使用适应不良的情绪调节策略，并在有效实施适应性策略方面存在困难。然而，这些情绪调节困难背后的机制仍不清楚。抑郁症的认知理论长期以来关注增加抑郁风险并维持抑郁发作的认知因素，但重度抑郁症的认知与情感方面之间的联系仍有待探索。我们提出，与抑郁症相关的认知偏差和认知控制缺陷以关键方式影响情绪调节，从而为持续负性情绪和正性情绪水平降低创造条件。最后，我们讨论了这些发现对治疗的启示以及该领域的未来研究方向。  
关键词：情绪调节；抑郁症；认知偏差；认知控制；正性情绪

title: Situation Selection and Modification for Emotion Regulation in Younger and Older Adults
summary: This research investigated age differences in use and effectiveness of situation selection and situation modification for emotion regulation. Socioemotional selectivity theory suggests stronger emotional well-being goals in older age; emotion regulation may support this goal. Younger and older adults assigned to an emotion regulation or “just view” condition first freely chose to engage with negative, neutral, or positive material (situation selection), then chose to view or skip negative and positive material (situation modification), rating affect after each experience. In both tasks, older adults in both goal conditions demonstrated pro-hedonic emotion regulation, spending less time with negative material compared to younger adults. Younger adults in the regulate condition also engaged in pro-hedonic situation selection, but not modification. Although situation selection was related to affect, modification of negative material was not. This research supports more frequent pro-hedonic motivation in older age, as well as age differences in use of early stage emotion regulation.

标题：年轻人和老年人情绪调节中的情境选择与情境修改  
摘要：本研究探讨了年龄差异在情境选择和情境修改用于情绪调节中的使用及其有效性。社会情绪选择性理论认为，老年人更注重情绪幸福感目标；情绪调节可能支持这一目标。年轻人和老年人被分配到情绪调节组或“仅观看”组，首先自由选择接触负面、中性或正面材料（情境选择），然后选择观看或跳过负面和正面材料（情境修改），并在每次体验后评估情绪影响。在这两项任务中，老年人在两种目标条件下均表现出亲快感情绪调节，与年轻人相比，他们花在负面材料上的时间更少。处于调节条件下的年轻人也参与了亲快感情境选择，但未进行情境修改。尽管情境选择与情绪相关，但负面材料的修改则不然。本研究支持了老年人更频繁表现出亲快感动机，以及早期阶段情绪调节使用中的年龄差异。  
关键词：情绪调节；年龄差异；情境选择；情境修改；亲快感动机

title: Social Baseline Theory: The Role of Social Proximity in Emotion and Economy of Action
summary:
Abstract
                  Social proximity and interaction attenuate cardiovascular arousal, facilitate the development of nonanxious temperament, inhibit the release of stress hormones, reduce threat‐related neural activation, and generally promote health and longevity. Conversely, social subordination, rejection and isolation are powerful sources of stress and compromised health. Drawing on the biological principle of economy of action, perception/action links, and the brain’s propensity to act as a Bayesian predictor, Social Baseline Theory (SBT) proposes that the primary ecology to which human beings are adapted is one that is rich with other humans. Moreover, SBT suggests that the presence of other people helps individuals to conserve important and often metabolically costly somatic and neural resources through the social regulation of emotion.
translation:
相关性：是
标题：社会基线理论：社会亲近性在情绪与动作经济中的作用
摘要：社会亲近性和互动能够减弱心血管唤醒，促进非焦虑气质的形成，抑制应激激素的释放，减少与威胁相关的神经激活，并普遍促进健康与长寿。相反，社会从属、排斥和孤立则是压力和健康受损的重要来源。基于动作经济的生物学原理、感知/行动联系以及大脑作为贝叶斯预测器的倾向，社会基线理论（SBT）提出，人类适应的主要生态环境是一个充满其他个体的环境。此外，SBT表明，他人的存在通过情绪的社会调节帮助个体节省重要且通常代谢成本高昂的躯体与神经资源。
关键词：社会亲近性，情绪，动作经济，社会调节，神经资源

title: Ketamine and facial emotion recognition in treatment-resistant depression: a computational account
summary: Background: Facial emotion recognition deficits are well defined in depression but understudied in treatment-resistant depression (TRD). Over the past decades, subanesthetic doses of ketamine have emerged as an effective treatment for TRD, but its effect on affective processing is still little known. Approaches from computational psychiatry, such as sequential evidence sampling models of decision making, can provide useful insight into the underlying cognitive processes of facial emotion recognition in TRD patients before and after ketamine antidepressant treatment.Aim: Provide a computational account of facial emotion recognition in TRD and the effects of ketamine treatment using hierarchical drift diffusion modeling (HDDM).Method: In this observational case-control study, 24 TRD patients and 35 healthy controls completed a FER task. TRD patients were assessed before, 2-4 hours after the initial racemic ketamine infusion, and at one week of treatment. Healthy controls were assessed at similar intervals, without intervention, to assess baseline differences and potential learning effects related to task repetition. Accuracy and reaction times were analyzed and fit with an HDDM to formalize correct facial emotion recognition as a noisy evidence-accumulation process. Parameters of the best-fitting model were compared across groups and timepoints.Results: Before treatment, TRD patients were slower but as accurate as controls. Following ketamine, the patients were significantly faster than at baseline and compared with repeated testing in healthy controls. These effects were underpinned by longer nondecision times and wider decision boundaries in patients at baseline, both of which decreased after starting ketamine. There was no behavioral or computational evidence of a negative bias in patients.Conclusions: Results suggest that processes related to psychomotor slowing and response caution, rather than affective processing, underlie deficits observed during facial emotion recognition in TRD and can be restored after starting a ketamine treatment.

标题：氯胺酮与难治性抑郁症的面部表情识别：一种计算视角
摘要：背景：面部表情识别缺陷在抑郁症中已有明确描述，但在难治性抑郁症中研究不足。过去几十年，亚麻醉剂量的氯胺酮已成为治疗难治性抑郁症的有效方法，但其对情感处理的影响仍知之甚少。计算精神病学的方法，如决策的序列证据采样模型，可为理解难治性抑郁症患者在氯胺酮抗抑郁治疗前后面部表情识别的潜在认知过程提供有价值的见解。目的：使用分层漂移扩散模型，从计算角度阐述难治性抑郁症中面部表情识别的表现以及氯胺酮治疗的影响。方法：在这项观察性病例对照研究中，24名难治性抑郁症患者和35名健康对照完成了一项面部表情识别任务。难治性抑郁症患者在初始消旋氯胺酮输注前、输注后2-4小时以及治疗一周后进行评估。健康对照以相似的时间间隔进行评估，但无干预，以评估基线差异以及与任务重复相关的潜在学习效应。分析准确率和反应时间，并使用分层漂移扩散模型进行拟合，将正确的面部表情识别形式化为一个带噪声的证据积累过程。比较最佳拟合模型的参数在各组和各时间点间的差异。结果：治疗前，难治性抑郁症患者反应较慢，但准确率与对照组相当。氯胺酮治疗后，患者反应速度显著快于基线，且与健康对照重复测试相比也更快。这些效应源于患者基线时更长的非决策时间和更宽的决策边界，两者在开始氯胺酮治疗后均下降。未发现患者在行为或计算证据上存在负性偏差。结论：结果表明，与精神运动迟缓和反应谨慎相关的过程，而非情感处理，是难治性抑郁症患者面部表情识别中观察到的缺陷的基础，且这些缺陷在开始氯胺酮治疗后可以得到恢复。
关键词：面部表情识别；难治性抑郁症；氯胺酮；分层漂移扩散模型；计算精神病学

title: Why Do People Regulate Their Emotions? A Taxonomy of Motives in Emotion Regulation
summary: Emotion regulation involves the pursuit of desired emotional states (i.e., emotion goals) in the service of superordinate motives. The nature and consequences of emotion regulation, therefore, are likely to depend on the motives it is intended to serve. Nonetheless, limited attention has been devoted to studying what motivates emotion regulation. By mapping the potential benefits of emotion to key human motives, this review identifies key classes of motives in emotion regulation. The proposed taxonomy distinguishes between hedonic motives that target the immediate phenomenology of emotions, and instrumental motives that target other potential benefits of emotions. Instrumental motives include behavioral, epistemic, social, and eudaimonic motives. The proposed taxonomy offers important implications for understanding the mechanism of emotion regulation, variation across individuals and contexts, and psychological function and dysfunction, and points to novel research directions.

标题：人们为何调节情绪？情绪调节动机的分类学
摘要：情绪调节涉及在更高级动机的支配下追求期望的情绪状态（即情绪目标）。因此，情绪调节的性质和后果可能取决于其所要服务的动机。尽管如此，目前对情绪调节动机的研究关注有限。通过将情绪的潜在收益映射到关键的人类动机上，本综述识别了情绪调节中的主要动机类别。提出的分类学区分了旨在影响情绪即时现象学的享乐动机，以及针对情绪其他潜在收益的工具性动机。工具性动机包括行为动机、认知动机、社会动机和幸福动机。该分类学为理解情绪调节机制、个体与情境差异以及心理功能与功能障碍提供了重要启示，并指出了新的研究方向。
关键词：情绪调节；动机；享乐动机；工具性动机；分类学

title: Selection, Optimization, and Compensation in the Domain of Emotion Regulation: Applications to Adolescence, Older Age, and Major Depressive Disorder
summary:
Abstract
                  Emotions often are well calibrated to the challenges and opportunities we face. When they are not, we may try to regulate our emotions. Interestingly, there seems to be considerable variation both in the strategies people use to regulate emotions and in the success of these emotion regulation efforts. The Selection, Optimization, and Compensation with Emotion Regulation framework suggests that variation in the resources required for particular emotion regulation strategies may be a crucial determinant of emotion regulation use and success within individuals across situations, between individuals, and between groups of individuals. In this review, we consider the ways in which two resources for emotion regulation (working memory and social support) might differ among three groups, namely adolescents, older adults, and adults with major depressive disorder. We link these between‐group differences in resources to differences in emotion regulation and make suggestions for future research.

标题：情绪调节领域的“选择、优化与补偿”框架：在青少年、老年及重性抑郁障碍中的应用  
摘要：情绪通常能够很好地校准我们所面临的挑战与机遇。当情绪校准失当时，我们可能会尝试调节情绪。有趣的是，人们在调节情绪时所使用的策略以及这些调节努力的成功程度存在显著差异。基于情绪调节的选择、优化与补偿框架表明，特定情绪调节策略所需资源的差异，可能是决定个体在不同情境下、个体之间以及群体之间情绪调节使用与成功与否的关键因素。在本综述中，我们探讨了三种群体（即青少年、老年人及重性抑郁障碍成人）在两种情绪调节资源（工作记忆与社会支持）上的可能差异，并将这些群体间资源差异与情绪调节差异联系起来，同时为未来研究提出建议。  
关键词：情绪调节；选择、优化与补偿；资源差异；工作记忆；社会支持
